big_case.notes: Twelve-state application, parallel to the Solicitor General's own (26A124), to stay a nationwide injunction against a presidential executive order on election administration months before the 2026 midterms; roughly 35 states across the caption, response requested same day, referred to the Court, amici filed. Among the highest-stakes interim matters of the Term.

leakage.notes: Forward cell created 2026-08-20, four days before the 2026-08-24 resolution, so no outcome existed to retrieve. Web searches were case-background queries; the candidate disclosed that one result (dated 2026-08-12, post-cutoff) headlined another injunction in parallel litigation, was not opened, and revealed nothing about this application's disposition — an honest disclosure that counts for the cell's integrity, and legitimate forward signal in any case. The one corpus query returned recency-ranked priors, not this case.
